scope: Lean differentiates the actual physical resolvent and Yosida Hamiltonian in operator norm and proves the exact derivative quadratic pairing. The completed-square identity bounds initial Yosida energy by the closed form energy. Along the constructed bounded evolution, its energy derivative lies between zero and twice its energy. This gives an all-time energy bound independent of the Yosida cutoff for initial data in the common form domain. The bounded energy E_a is controlled. The smoothed state a R_a psi_a lies in the original form domain with a uniform form-energy bound, has squared distance at most that bound divided by a from psi_a, and satisfies the exact weak pairing with the derivative of psi_a. This does not prove form domain invariance of each unsmoothed trajectory. These computations check transcription only. Convergence of the evolutions, an unbounded propagator, the full six-mode infinite model, regulator removal, physical identification and TOE remain open.
